section ‹Conditional String Rewriting›

theory Conditional_String_Rewriting
  imports
   "HOL-Library.Sublist"
   String_Rewriting
   ShortLex
begin

type_synonym csrule = "srule × srule list"

text ‹A conditional semi-Thue system›
type_synonym csts = "csrule set"

text ‹A conditional join string rewriting step of level @{term n}.›
fun csr_p_join_step_n :: "csts ⇒ nat ⇒ string rel"
where
  "csr_p_join_step_n R 0 = {}" |
  csr_p_join_step_n_Suc: "csr_p_join_step_n R (Suc n) =
    {(C⟪l⟫, C⟪r⟫) | C l r cs.
      ((l, r), cs) ∈ R ∧ (∀ (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R n)⇧↓)}"

(* Definition 24, second part *)
definition "csr_p_join_step R = (⋃n. csr_p_join_step_n R n)"

fun csr_semi_equational_step_n :: "csts ⇒ nat ⇒ string rel"
where
  "csr_semi_equational_step_n R 0 = {}" |
  csr_semi_equational_step_n_Suc: "csr_semi_equational_step_n R (Suc n) =
    {(C⟪l⟫, C⟪r⟫) | C l r cs.
      ((l, r), cs) ∈ R ∧ (∀ (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧↔⇧*)}"

(* Definition 24, first part *)
definition "csr_semi_equational_step R = (⋃n. csr_semi_equational_step_n R n)"

fun csr_r_join_step_n :: "csts ⇒ nat ⇒ string rel"
where
  "csr_r_join_step_n R 0 = {}" |
  csr_r_join_step_n_Suc: "csr_r_join_step_n R (Suc n) =
    {(C⟪l @ w⟫, C⟪r @ w⟫) | C l r cs w.
      ((l, r), cs) ∈ R ∧ (∀ (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i @ w, t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_r_join_step_n R n)⇧↓)}"

(* Definition 23, second part *)
definition "csr_r_join_step R = (⋃n. csr_r_join_step_n R n)"

fun csr_r_semi_equational_step_n :: "csts ⇒ nat ⇒ string rel"
where
  "csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R 0 = {}" |
  csr_r_semi_equational_step_n_Suc: "csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R (Suc n) =
    {(C⟪l @ w⟫, C⟪r @ w⟫) | C l r cs w.
      ((l, r), cs) ∈ R ∧ (∀ (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i @ w, t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧↔⇧*)}"

(* Definition 23, first part *)
definition "csr_r_semi_equational_step R = (⋃n. csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R n)"

fun csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n :: "csts ⇒ nat ⇒ string rel"
where
  "csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R 0 = {}" |
  csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n_Suc: "csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R (Suc n) =
    {(C⟪u @ l @ w⟫, C⟪u @ r @ w⟫) | C l r cs u w.
      ((l, r), cs) ∈ R ∧ (∀ (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧↔⇧*)}"

(* Definition 22, first part *)
definition "csr_lr_semi_equational_step R = (⋃n. csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R n)"

fun csr_lr_join_step_n :: "csts ⇒ nat ⇒ string rel"
where
  "csr_lr_join_step_n R 0 = {}" |
  csr_lr_join_step_n_Suc: "csr_lr_join_step_n R (Suc n) =
    {(C⟪u @ l @ w⟫, C⟪u @ r @ w⟫) | C l r cs u w.
      ((l, r), cs) ∈ R ∧ (∀ (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_join_step_n R n)⇧↓)}"

(* Definition 22, second part *)
definition "csr_lr_join_step R = (⋃n. csr_lr_join_step_n R n)"

definition app_list :: "string ⇒ srule list ⇒ srule list"
where
  "app_list y ls = map (λ(lhs, rhs). (lhs @ y, rhs @ y)) ls"

lemma csr_p_join_step_iff:
  "(s, t) ∈ csr_p_join_step R ⟷ (∃n. (s, t) ∈ csr_p_join_step_n R n)"
  by (auto simp: csr_p_join_step_def)

lemma csr_semi_equational_step_iff:
  "(s, t) ∈ csr_semi_equational_step R ⟷ (∃n. (s, t) ∈ csr_semi_equational_step_n R n)"
  by (auto simp: csr_semi_equational_step_def)

lemma csr_lr_join_step_iff:
  "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_join_step R ⟷ (∃n. (s, t) ∈ csr_lr_join_step_n R n)"
  by (auto simp: csr_lr_join_step_def)

lemma csr_r_join_step_iff:
  "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_join_step R ⟷ (∃n. (s, t) ∈ csr_r_join_step_n R n)"
  by (auto simp: csr_r_join_step_def)

lemma csr_r_semi_equational_step_iff:
  "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_semi_equational_step R ⟷ (∃n. (s, t) ∈ csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R n)"
  by (auto simp: csr_r_semi_equational_step_def)

lemma csr_lr_semi_equational_step_iff:
  "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_semi_equational_step R ⟷ (∃n. (s, t) ∈ csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R n)"
  by (auto simp: csr_lr_semi_equational_step_def)

lemma csr_p_join_step_n_imp_cstep:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_p_join_step_n R n"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_p_join_step R"
  using assms by (auto simp: csr_p_join_step_iff)

lemma csr_semi_equational_step_n_imp_cstep:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_semi_equational_step_n R n"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_semi_equational_step R"
  using assms by (auto simp: csr_semi_equational_step_iff)

lemma csr_lr_join_step_n_imp_cstep:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_join_step_n R n"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_join_step R"
  using assms by (auto simp: csr_lr_join_step_iff)

lemma csr_r_join_step_n_imp_cstep:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_join_step_n R n"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_join_step R"
  using assms by (auto simp: csr_r_join_step_iff)

lemma csr_r_semi_equational_step_n_imp_cstep:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R n"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_semi_equational_step R"
  using assms by (auto simp: csr_r_semi_equational_step_iff)

lemma csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n_imp_cstep:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R n"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_semi_equational_step R"
  using assms by (auto simp: csr_lr_semi_equational_step_iff)

lemma csr_p_join_steps_n_imp_csteps:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R n)⇧*"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ (csr_p_join_step R)⇧*"
  using assms by (induct; auto dest: csr_p_join_step_n_imp_cstep)

lemma csr_semi_equational_steps_n_imp_csr_semi_equational_steps:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧↔⇧*"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step R)⇧↔⇧*"
  using assms by (induct; auto dest: csr_semi_equational_step_n_imp_cstep) 
    (metis conversion_mono csr_semi_equational_step_n_imp_cstep old.prod.exhaust subset_eq)

lemma csr_lr_join_steps_n_imp_csteps:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_lr_join_step_n R n)⇧*"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ (csr_lr_join_step R)⇧*"
  using assms by (induct; auto dest: csr_lr_join_step_n_imp_cstep)

lemma csr_r_join_steps_n_imp_csteps:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_r_join_step_n R n)⇧*"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ (csr_r_join_step R)⇧*"
  using assms by (induct; auto dest: csr_r_join_step_n_imp_cstep)

lemma csr_r_semi_equational_steps_n_imp_csteps:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧*"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ (csr_r_semi_equational_step R)⇧*"

lemma csr_lr_semi_equational_steps_n_imp_csteps:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧*"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ (csr_lr_semi_equational_step R)⇧*"
  using assms by (induct; auto dest: csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n_imp_cstep)

lemma csr_p_join_steps_n_subset_csteps:
  "(csr_p_join_step_n R n)⇧* ⊆ (csr_p_join_step R)⇧*"
  by (auto dest: csr_p_join_steps_n_imp_csteps)

lemma csr_semi_equational_steps_n_subset_csr_semi_equational_steps:
  "(csr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧* ⊆ (csr_semi_equational_step R)⇧*"
  by (auto, metis csr_semi_equational_step_iff rtrancl_mono subset_eq surj_pair)

lemma csr_lr_join_steps_n_subset_csteps:
  "(csr_lr_join_step_n R n)⇧* ⊆ (csr_lr_join_step R)⇧*"
  by (auto dest: csr_lr_join_steps_n_imp_csteps)

lemma csr_r_join_steps_n_subset_csteps:
  "(csr_r_join_step_n R n)⇧* ⊆ (csr_r_join_step R)⇧*"

lemma csr_r_semi_equational_steps_n_subset_csteps:
  "(csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧* ⊆ (csr_r_semi_equational_step R)⇧*"

lemma csr_lr_semi_equational_steps_n_subset_csteps:
  "(csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧* ⊆ (csr_lr_semi_equational_step R)⇧*"
  by (auto dest: csr_lr_semi_equational_steps_n_imp_csteps)

lemma csr_p_join_step_n_SucI [Pure.intro?]:
  assumes "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R n)⇧↓"
    and "s = C⟪l⟫ "
    and "t = C⟪r⟫"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_p_join_step_n R (Suc n)"
  using assms by auto

lemma csr_semi_equational_step_n_SucI [Pure.intro?]:
  assumes "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧↔⇧*"
    and "s = C⟪l⟫ "
    and "t = C⟪r⟫"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_semi_equational_step_n R (Suc n)"
  using assms by auto

lemma csr_lr_join_step_n_SucI [Pure.intro?]:
  assumes "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_join_step_n R n)⇧↓"
    and "s = C⟪u @ l @ w⟫ "
    and "t = C⟪u @ r @ w⟫"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_join_step_n R (Suc n)"
  using assms by fastforce

  assumes "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i @ w, t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧↔⇧*"

lemma csr_p_join_step_n_SucE:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_p_join_step_n R (Suc n)"
  obtains C l r cs where "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R n)⇧↓"
    and "s = C⟪l⟫"
    and "t = C⟪r⟫"
  using assms by auto

lemma csr_semi_equational_step_n_SucE:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_semi_equational_step_n R (Suc n)"
  obtains C l r cs where "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧↔⇧*"
    and "s = C⟪l⟫"
    and "t = C⟪r⟫"
  using assms by auto

lemma csr_lr_join_step_n_SucE:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_join_step_n R (Suc n)"
  obtains C D l r cs u w where "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_join_step_n R n)⇧↓"
    and "s = C⟪u @ l @ w⟫"
    and "t = C⟪u @ r @ w⟫"
  using assms by auto

  obtains C l r w cs where "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i @ w, t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_r_join_step_n R n)⇧↓"
    and "s = C⟪l @ w⟫"

  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R (Suc n)"
  obtains C l r u w cs where "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧↔⇧*"

lemma csr_p_join_step_n_E:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_p_join_step_n R n"
  obtains C l r w cs n' where "((l, r), cs) ∈ R" and "n = Suc n'"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R n')⇧↓"
    and "s = C⟪l⟫"
    and "t = C⟪r⟫"
  using assms by (cases n, auto)

lemma csr_p_join_step_n_Suc_mono:
  "csr_p_join_step_n R n ⊆ csr_p_join_step_n R (Suc n)"
proof (induct n)
  case (Suc n)
  show ?case
    using rtrancl_mono [OF Suc] 
    by (auto, smt (z3) in_mono join_def join_mono rtrancl_converse rtrancl_idemp)
qed simp

lemma csr_semi_equational_step_n_Suc_mono:
  "csr_semi_equational_step_n R n ⊆ csr_semi_equational_step_n R (Suc n)"
proof (induct n)
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case by (auto, smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) conversion_mono in_mono)
qed simp

lemma csr_lr_join_step_n_Suc_mono:
  "csr_lr_join_step_n R n ⊆ csr_lr_join_step_n R (Suc n)"
proof (induct n)
  case (Suc n)
  show ?case
    using rtrancl_mono [OF Suc] 
    by (auto elim!: csr_lr_join_step_n_SucE intro!: csr_lr_join_step_n_SucI) 
      (smt (z3) case_prodD case_prodI2 in_mono joinD joinI)
qed simp

lemma csr_r_join_step_n_Suc_mono:
  "csr_r_join_step_n R n ⊆ csr_r_join_step_n R (Suc n)"
proof (induct n)
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case
    by (auto, smt (z3) case_prodD case_prodI2 in_mono join_mono) 
qed simp

lemma csr_r_semi_equational_step_n_Suc_mono:
  "csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R n ⊆ csr_r_semi_equational_step_n R (Suc n)"
proof (induct n)
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case using conversion_mono
    by (auto, smt (z3) case_prodD case_prodI2 in_mono) 
qed simp

lemma csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n_Suc_mono:

proof (induct n)

lemma csr_p_join_step_n_mono:
  assumes "i ≤ n"
  shows "csr_p_join_step_n R i ⊆ csr_p_join_step_n R n"
using assms
proof (induct "n - i" arbitrary: i)
  case (Suc k)
  hence "k = n - Suc i" and "Suc i ≤ n" by arith+
  hence "csr_p_join_step_n R (Suc i) ⊆ csr_p_join_step_n R n" using Suc.hyps by blast
  then show ?case 
    by (auto, meson csr_p_join_step_n_Suc_mono in_mono)
qed simp

lemma csr_p_join_steps_imp_csr_p_join_steps_n:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_p_join_step R)⇧↓"
  shows "∃n. (s, t) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R n)⇧↓"
proof -
  from assms obtain u where su:"(s, u) ∈ (csr_p_join_step R)⇧*" and tu:"(t, u) ∈ (csr_p_join_step R)⇧*" by auto
  from su have *:"∃m. (s, u) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R m)⇧*" using csr_p_join_steps_imp_csr_steps_n by blast
  from tu have **:"∃n. (t, u) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R n)⇧*" using csr_p_join_steps_imp_csr_steps_n by blast
  from * ** have "∃max. (s, u) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R max)⇧* ∧ (t, u) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R max)⇧*" 
    by (meson csr_p_join_step_n_mono in_mono linorder_le_cases rtrancl_mono)
  then show ?thesis by auto
qed

lemma csr_semi_equational_conv_steps_imp_csr_semi_equational_conv_steps_n:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step R)⇧↔⇧*"
  shows "∃n. (s, t) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧↔⇧*" 
proof -
  from assms obtain m where "(s, t) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step R)⇧↔^^m" by auto
  then show ?thesis
  proof(induct m arbitrary: t)
    case 0
    then show ?case by auto
  next
    case (Suc m)
    from Suc(2) obtain u where su:"(s, u) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step R)⇧↔ ^^ m" and ut:"(u, t) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step R)⇧↔" by auto
    from su Suc(1) obtain n where *:"(s, u) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step_n R n)⇧↔⇧*" by blast
    from ut obtain k where **:"(u, t) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step_n R k)⇧↔"
      using csr_semi_equational_step_iff by blast+
    from * ** have max:"∃max. (s, u) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step_n R max)⇧↔⇧* ∧ (u, t) ∈ (csr_semi_equational_step_n R max)⇧↔"
      using conversion_mono csr_semi_equational_step_n_mono nat_le_linear linorder_le_cases subsetD 
      by (auto, (smt (verit, best) conversion_mono subset_iff)+)
    then show ?case 
      by (auto, (metis conversion_def rtrancl.rtrancl_into_rtrancl)+)    
  qed
qed

lemma all_csr_p_join_step_imp_csr_step_n:
  assumes "∀i < (k::nat). (s⇩i i, t⇩i i) ∈ (csr_p_join_step R)⇧*"
  shows "∃n. ∀i < k. (s⇩i i, t⇩i i) ∈ (csr_p_join_step_n R n)⇧*" (is "∃n. ∀i < k. ?P i n")  using assms 
proof -
  have "∀i < k. ∃n⇩i. ?P i n⇩i"
    using assms csr_p_join_steps_imp_csr_steps_n by auto
  then obtain f where *: "∀i < k. ?P i (f i)" by metis
  define n where "n ≡ Max (set (map f [0 ..< k]))"
  have "∀i < k. f i ≤ n" by (auto simp: n_def)
  then have "∀i < k. ?P i n"
    using csr_p_join_step_n_mono [of "f i" n R for i, THEN rtrancl_mono] and * 
    by (meson joinD joinI subset_eq)
  then show ?thesis ..
qed

lemma csr_p_join_stepE [elim]:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_p_join_step R)"
    and imp: "⋀C l r cs. ⟦((l, r), cs) ∈ R; ∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_p_join_step R)⇧↓; 
      s = C⟪l⟫; t = C⟪r⟫⟧ ⟹ P"
  shows "P"
proof -
  obtain n where *: "(s, t) ∈ csr_p_join_step_n R n" using assms by (auto simp: csr_p_join_step_iff)
  then show ?thesis
  proof (cases n)
    case (Suc n')
    have **: "(csr_p_join_step_n R n')⇧* ⊆ (csr_p_join_step R)⇧*" by (rule rtrancl_mono) (auto simp: csr_p_join_step_iff)

      by (metis (no_types, lifting) csr_p_join_steps_n_imp_csteps imp joinD joinI split_beta')
  qed simp
qed

lemma csr_lr_semi_equational_stepE [elim]:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_lr_semi_equational_step R)"
    and imp: "⋀C l r cs u w. ⟦((l, r), cs) ∈ R; ∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_semi_equational_step R)⇧↔⇧*; 
      s = C⟪u @ l @ w⟫; t = C⟪u @ r @ w⟫⟧ ⟹ P"
  shows "P"
proof -
  obtain n where *: "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R n" using assms by (auto simp: csr_lr_semi_equational_step_iff)
  then show ?thesis
  proof (cases n)
    case (Suc n')
    have **: "(csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n R n')⇧↔⇧* ⊆ (csr_lr_semi_equational_step R)⇧↔⇧*" using csr_lr_semi_equational_step_iff
      by (meson conversion_mono in_mono subrelI)
    then show ?thesis using csr_lr_semi_equational_step_n_SucE [OF * [unfolded Suc]]
      by (smt (verit, best) imp split_beta' subset_iff)
  qed simp
qed


text ‹A conditional oriented string rewriting step of level @{term n}.›
fun csr_step_n :: "csts ⇒ nat ⇒ string rel"
where
  "csr_step_n R 0 = {}" |
  csr_step_n_Suc: "csr_step_n R (Suc n) =
    {(C⟪l⟫, C⟪r⟫) | C l r cs.
      ((l, r), cs) ∈ R ∧ (∀ (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_step_n R n)⇧*)}"

definition "csr_step R = (⋃n. csr_step_n R n)"

fun csr_lr_step_n :: "csts ⇒ nat ⇒ string rel"
where
  "csr_lr_step_n R 0 = {}" |
  csr_lr_step_n_Suc: "csr_lr_step_n R (Suc n) =
    {(C⟪u @ l @ w⟫, C⟪u @ r @ w⟫) | C l r u w cs.
      ((l, r), cs) ∈ R ∧ (∀ (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_step_n R n)⇧*)}"

definition "csr_lr_step R = (⋃n. csr_lr_step_n R n)"

fun csr_r_step_n :: "csts ⇒ nat ⇒ string rel"
where
  "csr_r_step_n R 0 = {}" |
  csr_r_step_n_Suc: "csr_r_step_n R (Suc n) =
    {(C⟪l @ w⟫, C⟪r @ w⟫) | C l r cs w.
      ((l, r), cs) ∈ R ∧ (∀ (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i @ w, t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_r_step_n R n)⇧*)}"

definition "csr_r_step R = (⋃n. csr_r_step_n R n)"

lemma csr_step_iff:
  "(s, t) ∈ csr_step R ⟷ (∃n. (s, t) ∈ csr_step_n R n)"
  by (auto simp: csr_step_def)

lemma csr_lr_step_iff:
  "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_step R ⟷ (∃n. (s, t) ∈ csr_lr_step_n R n)"
  by (auto simp: csr_lr_step_def)

lemma csr_r_step_iff:
  "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_step R ⟷ (∃n. (s, t) ∈ csr_r_step_n R n)"
  by (auto simp: csr_r_step_def)

lemma csr_step_n_imp_cstep:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_step_n R n"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_step R"
  using assms by (auto simp: csr_step_iff)

lemma csr_lr_step_n_imp_cstep:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_step_n R n"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_step R"
  using assms by (auto simp: csr_lr_step_iff)

lemma csr_r_step_n_imp_cstep:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_step_n R n"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_step R"
using assms by (auto simp: csr_r_step_iff)

lemma csr_steps_n_imp_csteps:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_step_n R n)⇧*"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ (csr_step R)⇧*"
  using assms by (induct; auto dest: csr_step_n_imp_cstep)

lemma csr_lr_steps_n_imp_csteps:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_lr_step_n R n)⇧*"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ (csr_lr_step R)⇧*"
  using assms by (induct; auto dest: csr_lr_step_n_imp_cstep)

lemma csr_r_steps_n_imp_csteps:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_r_step_n R n)⇧*"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ (csr_r_step R)⇧*"
using assms by (induct; auto dest: csr_r_step_n_imp_cstep)

lemma csr_steps_n_subset_csteps:
  "(csr_step_n R n)⇧* ⊆ (csr_step R)⇧*"
  by (auto dest: csr_steps_n_imp_csteps)

lemma csr_lr_steps_n_subset_csteps:
  "(csr_lr_step_n R n)⇧* ⊆ (csr_lr_step R)⇧*"
  by (auto dest: csr_lr_steps_n_imp_csteps)

lemma csr_r_steps_n_subset_csteps:
  "(csr_r_step_n R n)⇧* ⊆ (csr_r_step R)⇧*"
  by (auto dest: csr_r_steps_n_imp_csteps)

lemma csr_step_n_SucI [Pure.intro?]:
  assumes "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_step_n R n)⇧*"
    and "s = C⟪l⟫ "
    and "t = C⟪r⟫"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_step_n R (Suc n)"
  using assms by auto

lemma csr_lr_step_n_SucI [Pure.intro?]:
  assumes "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_step_n R n)⇧*"
    and "s = C⟪u @ l @ w⟫ "
    and "t = C⟪u @ r @ w⟫"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_step_n R (Suc n)"
  using assms by fastforce

lemma csr_r_step_n_SucI [Pure.intro?]:
  assumes "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i @ w, t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_r_step_n R n)⇧*"
    and "s = C⟪l @ w⟫ "
    and "t = C⟪r @ w⟫"
  shows "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_step_n R (Suc n)"
  using assms by fastforce

lemma csr_step_n_SucE:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_step_n R (Suc n)"
  obtains C l r σ cs where "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_step_n R n)⇧*"
    and "s = C⟪l⟫"
    and "t = C⟪r⟫"
  using assms by auto

lemma csr_lr_step_n_SucE:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_step_n R (Suc n)"
  obtains C D l r cs u w where "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_step_n R n)⇧*"
    and "s = C⟪u @ l @ w⟫"
    and "t = C⟪u @ r @ w⟫"
  using assms by auto

lemma csr_r_step_n_SucE:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_step_n R (Suc n)"
  obtains C l r w cs where "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i @ w, t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_r_step_n R n)⇧*"
    and "s = C⟪l @ w⟫"
    and "t = C⟪r @ w⟫"
  using assms by auto

lemma csr_r_step_n_E:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_step_n R n"
  obtains C l r w cs n' where "((l, r), cs) ∈ R" and "n = Suc n'"
    and "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i @ w, t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_r_step_n R n')⇧*"
    and "s = C⟪l @ w⟫"
    and "t = C⟪r @ w⟫"
  using assms by (cases n, auto)

lemma csr_step_n_Suc_mono:
  "csr_step_n R n ⊆ csr_step_n R (Suc n)"
proof (induct n)
  case (Suc n)
  show ?case
    using rtrancl_mono [OF Suc] by (auto elim!: csr_step_n_SucE intro!: csr_step_n_SucI, blast)
qed simp

lemma csr_lr_step_n_Suc_mono:
  "csr_lr_step_n R n ⊆ csr_lr_step_n R (Suc n)"
proof (induct n)
  case (Suc n)
  show ?case
    using rtrancl_mono [OF Suc] by (auto elim!: csr_lr_step_n_SucE intro!: csr_lr_step_n_SucI, blast)
qed simp

lemma csr_r_step_n_Suc_mono:
  "csr_r_step_n R n ⊆ csr_r_step_n R (Suc n)"
proof (induct n)
  case (Suc n)
  show ?case
    using rtrancl_mono [OF Suc] by (auto elim!: csr_r_step_n_SucE intro!: csr_r_step_n_SucI, blast)
qed simp

lemma csr_step_n_mono:
  assumes "i ≤ n"
  shows "csr_step_n R i ⊆ csr_step_n R n"
using assms
proof (induct "n - i" arbitrary: i)
  case (Suc k)
  hence "k = n - Suc i" and "Suc i ≤ n" by arith+
  hence "csr_step_n R (Suc i) ⊆ csr_step_n R n" using Suc.hyps by blast
  then show ?case 
    by (auto, meson csr_step_n_Suc_mono in_mono)
qed simp

lemma csr_lr_step_n_mono:
  assumes "i ≤ n"
  shows "csr_lr_step_n R i ⊆ csr_lr_step_n R n"
using assms
proof (induct "n - i" arbitrary: i)
  case (Suc k)
  hence "k = n - Suc i" and "Suc i ≤ n" by arith+
  hence "csr_lr_step_n R (Suc i) ⊆ csr_lr_step_n R n" using Suc.hyps by blast
  then show ?case 
    by (auto, meson csr_lr_step_n_Suc_mono in_mono)
qed simp

lemma csr_r_step_n_mono:
  assumes "i ≤ n"
  shows "csr_r_step_n R i ⊆ csr_r_step_n R n"
using assms
proof (induct "n - i" arbitrary: i)
  case (Suc k)
  hence "k = n - Suc i" and "Suc i ≤ n" by arith+
  hence "csr_r_step_n R (Suc i) ⊆ csr_r_step_n R n" using Suc.hyps by blast
  then show ?case 
    by (auto, meson csr_r_step_n_Suc_mono in_mono)
qed simp

lemma csr_steps_imp_csr_steps_n:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_step R)⇧*"
  shows "∃n. (s, t) ∈ (csr_step_n R n)⇧*"
  using assms csr_step_iff 
  by (induct, auto, meson csr_step_n_mono linorder_linear rtrancl.rtrancl_into_rtrancl rtrancl_mono subsetD)

lemma csr_lr_steps_imp_csr_lr_steps_n:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_lr_step R)⇧*"
  shows "∃n. (s, t) ∈ (csr_lr_step_n R n)⇧*"
  using assms csr_lr_step_iff 
  by (induct, auto, meson csr_lr_step_n_mono linorder_linear rtrancl.rtrancl_into_rtrancl rtrancl_mono subsetD) 

lemma csr_r_steps_imp_csr_r_steps_n:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ (csr_r_step R)⇧*"
  shows "∃n. (s, t) ∈ (csr_r_step_n R n)⇧*"
  using assms csr_r_step_iff 
  by (induct, auto, meson csr_r_step_n_mono linorder_linear rtrancl.rtrancl_into_rtrancl rtrancl_mono subsetD) 

lemma all_csr_step_imp_csr_step_n:
  assumes "∀i < (k::nat). (s⇩i i, t⇩i i) ∈ (csr_step R)⇧*"
  shows "∃n. ∀i < k. (s⇩i i, t⇩i i) ∈ (csr_step_n R n)⇧*" (is "∃n. ∀i < k. ?P i n")  using assms 
proof -
  have "∀i < k. ∃n⇩i. ?P i n⇩i"
    using assms by (auto intro: csr_steps_imp_csr_steps_n)
  then obtain f where *: "∀i < k. ?P i (f i)" by metis
  define n where "n ≡ Max (set (map f [0 ..< k]))"
  have "∀i < k. f i ≤ n" by (auto simp: n_def)
  then have "∀i < k. ?P i n"
    using csr_step_n_mono [of "f i" n R for i, THEN rtrancl_mono] and * by blast
  then show ?thesis ..
qed

lemma all_csr_lr_step_imp_csr_lr_step_n:
  assumes "∀i < (k::nat). (s⇩i i, t⇩i i) ∈ (csr_lr_step R)⇧*"
  shows "∃n. ∀i < k. (s⇩i i, t⇩i i) ∈ (csr_lr_step_n R n)⇧*" (is "∃n. ∀i < k. ?P i n")  using assms 
proof -
  have "∀i < k. ∃n⇩i. ?P i n⇩i"
    using assms by (auto intro: csr_lr_steps_imp_csr_lr_steps_n)
  then obtain f where *: "∀i < k. ?P i (f i)" by metis
  define n where "n ≡ Max (set (map f [0 ..< k]))"
  have "∀i < k. f i ≤ n" by (auto simp: n_def)
  then have "∀i < k. ?P i n"
    using csr_lr_step_n_mono [of "f i" n R for i, THEN rtrancl_mono] and * by blast
  then show ?thesis ..
qed

lemma all_csr_r_step_imp_csr_r_step_n:
  assumes "∀i < (k::nat). (s⇩i i, t⇩i i) ∈ (csr_r_step R)⇧*"
  shows "∃n. ∀i < k. (s⇩i i, t⇩i i) ∈ (csr_r_step_n R n)⇧*" (is "∃n. ∀i < k. ?P i n")  using assms 
proof -
  have "∀i < k. ∃n⇩i. ?P i n⇩i"
    using assms by (auto intro: csr_r_steps_imp_csr_r_steps_n)
  then obtain f where *: "∀i < k. ?P i (f i)" by metis
  define n where "n ≡ Max (set (map f [0 ..< k]))"
  have "∀i < k. f i ≤ n" by (auto simp: n_def)
  then have "∀i < k. ?P i n"
    using csr_r_step_n_mono [of "f i" n R for i, THEN rtrancl_mono] and * by blast
  then show ?thesis ..
qed

lemma csr_stepI:
  assumes "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and conds: "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_step R)⇧*"
  shows "(l, r) ∈ csr_step R" using assms 
proof -
  obtain n where "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ (csr_step_n R n)⇧*"
  using all_csr_step_imp_csr_step_n[of "length cs" "λi. fst (cs ! i)" "λi. snd (cs ! i)" R]
  and conds
    by (auto simp: all_set_conv_all_nth split_beta')
  hence "(l, r) ∈ csr_step_n R (Suc n)" using assms csr_step_n_SucI
    by (metis sctxt.cop_nil)
  then show ?thesis using csr_step_iff by blast
qed

lemma csr_lr_stepI:
  assumes "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and conds: "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_step R)⇧*"
  shows "(C⟪u @ l @ w⟫, C⟪u @ r @ w⟫) ∈ csr_lr_step R" using assms 
proof -
  obtain n where "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (u @ s⇩i @ w, u @ t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_lr_step_n R n)⇧*"
  using all_csr_lr_step_imp_csr_lr_step_n[of "length cs" "λi. u @ fst (cs ! i) @ w" "λi. u @ snd (cs ! i) @ w" R]
  and conds assms
  by (auto simp: all_set_conv_all_nth split_beta') 
  hence "(C⟪u @ l @ w⟫, C⟪u @ r @ w⟫) ∈ csr_lr_step_n R (Suc n)" using assms csr_lr_step_n_SucI 
    by blast
  then show ?thesis using csr_lr_step_iff by blast
qed

lemma csr_r_stepI:
  assumes "((l, r), cs) ∈ R"
    and conds: "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i @ w, t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_r_step R)⇧*"
  shows "(C⟪l @ w⟫, C⟪r @ w⟫) ∈ csr_r_step R" using assms 
proof -
  obtain n where "∀(s⇩i, t⇩i) ∈ set cs. (s⇩i @ w, t⇩i @ w) ∈ (csr_r_step_n R n)⇧*"
  using all_csr_r_step_imp_csr_r_step_n[of "length cs" "λi. fst (cs ! i) @ w" "λi. snd (cs ! i) @ w" R]
  and conds assms
  by (auto simp: all_set_conv_all_nth split_beta') 
  then have "(C⟪l @ w⟫, C⟪r @ w⟫) ∈ csr_r_step_n R (Suc n)" using assms csr_r_step_n_SucI 
    by blast
  then show ?thesis using csr_r_step_iff by blast
qed

lemma csr_step_n_ctxt:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_step_n R n"
  shows "(C⟪s⟫, C⟪t⟫) ∈ csr_step_n R n" using assms
  by (cases n, auto, metis sctxt.cop_add, insert csr_step_n_SucE)

lemma csr_lr_step_n_ctxt:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_lr_step_n R n"
  shows "(C⟪s⟫, C⟪t⟫) ∈ csr_lr_step_n R n" using assms
  by (cases n, auto, metis (no_types, lifting) sctxt.cop_add)

lemma csr_r_step_n_ctxt:
  assumes "(s, t) ∈ csr_r_step_n R n"
  shows "(C⟪s⟫, C⟪t⟫) ∈ csr_r_step_n R n" using assms csr_r_step_n_SucE
  by (cases n, auto, metis (no_types, lifting) sctxt.cop_add)

lemma csr_step_ctxt_closed:
  "sctxt.closed (csr_step R)"
  by (rule sctxt.closedI) (auto intro: csr_step_n_ctxt simp: csr_step_iff)

lemma csr_lr_step_ctxt_closed:
  "sctxt.closed (csr_lr_step R)"
  by (rule sctxt.closedI) (auto intro: csr_lr_step_n_ctxt simp: csr_lr_step_iff)

lemma csr_r_step_ctxt_closed:
  "sctxt.closed (csr_r_step R)"
  by (rule sctxt.closedI) (auto intro: csr_r_step_n_ctxt simp: csr_r_step_iff)

end
